gloss: something extraordinary; something serious; an extreme situation

definitions.gloss: something extraordinary; something serious; an extreme situation
definitions.explanation: Refers to an unusually significant or extreme circumstance. Often used in conditional sentences to express that only under exceptional conditions would something happen.

examples.japanese: {余程|よほど}の{事|こと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧、⟦{休|やす}みません→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: Unless something extraordinary happens, I won't take a day off.

examples.japanese: {余程|よほど}の{事|こと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{遅刻|ちこく}しない→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I won't be late unless something serious comes up.

examples.japanese: {余程|よほど}の{事|こと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だろう、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{顔色|かおいろ}→顔色：25468_kaoiro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{真|ま}っ{青|さお}→真っ青：07615_massao⟧だった。
examples.english: Something really serious must have happened — his face was deathly pale.

notes:
Combines ⟦{余程|よほど}→余程：10653_yohodo⟧ (considerably, quite) with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{事|こと} (thing, matter) to create a set expression meaning "something out of the ordinary." Almost always appears with negative conditions like ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧ (unless) or ⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧ (if not).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {余程|よほど}の{事|こと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧: unless something extraordinary happens
- {余程|よほど}の{事|こと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧: unless there's a serious reason
- {余程|よほど}の{事|こと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だろう: something extreme must have happened

USAGE:
This expression is frequently used to emphasize one's commitment or reliability — "I won't miss it unless something truly exceptional happens." It implies that the speaker's default action is firm and only extreme circumstances would change it.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{余程|よほど}→余程：10653_yohodo⟧: considerably, quite — the base adverb
- ⟦よっぽど→よっぽど：19326_yoppodo⟧: colloquial variant of ⟦{余程|よほど}→余程：10653_yohodo⟧
- ⟦{非常事態|ひじょうじたい}→非常事態：17519_hijoujitai⟧: emergency, state of emergency — describes the kind of situation {余程|よほど}の{事|こと} implies
